original_description: Design and edit motion graphics and visual assets with Stewdio. Create product launch animations, feature explainers, animated UI demos, and brand assets. Describe what you want to make with ChatGPT and refine the result with precise control in Stewdio's visual editor to adjust colors, typography, layout, animation timing, and much more. Preview your work as you edit, and discuss it with your team in Comments. Requires a Stewdio account.
